title: El legado revolucionario
goal: Read a closing account of the revolution's human cost, the PRI's seventy-year rule as its main institutional legacy, and how that stability came at the cost of one-party dominance.

items: State the approximate human cost of the revolution's most violent phase.
Explain what was created in Mexico in 1929 as the revolution's main institutional legacy.
Describe how this party managed to avoid a later revolution.
Explain what Mexico avoided thanks to this political stability, and at what cost.
Use no tanto... como to reframe an expected conclusion with a more precise one.
